youtube_title: The Red River Bridge War, 1931: martial law over the Durant-Denison bridge (viewer request)
body: You asked for Durant, Oklahoma! In July 1931, a new free bridge over the Red River, linking Durant and Denison, Texas, was finished, but the owners of the old toll bridge got a federal court order to keep it closed. Texas barricaded its end, and Texas Rangers were sent to guard it. Oklahoma's governor, 'Alfalfa Bill' Murray, had the barricades torn down, later called out the National Guard, declared martial law at the bridge, and showed up wearing a pistol. They called it the Red River Bridge War. No one was hurt. The free bridge officially opened on Labor Day, 1931, and carried traffic until the 1990s. A piece of it still sits in the city park in Colbert, Oklahoma. Comment your town, and it could be next! #Durant #Oklahoma #RedRiver #Texas #BryanCounty #History #LaPorteAfterDark
